svg.aria-label: htop: tech stack meters. FRONT: Angular · TypeScript · Ionic / Capacitor. BACK: NestJS · Node.js · PHP · 4D. DATA: PostgreSQL · CouchDB · Vespa. AI: RAG · Mistral · Claude agents · Python. OPS: Docker · Ansible · Keycloak · WireGuard. Running processes: navelys, cloud ERP suite + data platform replacing a legacy 4D ERP. docutalk, chat with your documents: RAG SaaS. microsimplis, bookkeeping & URSSAF filings for French micro-entrepreneurs. invoicing-sync, e-invoicing gateway: Factur-X, AFNOR flow API, ERP export. codingforge, the development farm itself: orchestrator, sub-agents, lot queue.
